name: Apprenticeship — Draft POST with mid-course price increase takes first price only (2627 AY)
description: POSTs a draft apprenticeship learner to the LearnerData Outer API with the apprenticeship starting in the 2627 academic year (running 2 years) and a Costs array carrying two elements — the original price from the start date, and a price increase taking effect 2 months in. Only the first (earliest) cost is taken on POST, so checks it lands as an unapproved draft with a single price row for the original price and that the later increase is ignored.

steps.name: SLD Create a Draft Apprenticeship with a mid-course price increase

assertions.name: Episode exists as an unapproved draft
Only the first cost row persisted
Persisted price is the initial price from start date
